## Context
The current README feels too dense and decorative for the intended recruiter-first audience. The user requested a cleaner profile with fewer sections, no banner visuals, stronger personal description aligned with LinkedIn positioning, and correct stack icons.

## Decision
Refactor README into a concise structure focused on identity, measurable outcomes, flagship work, selected projects, stack signal, and clear contact CTA. Remove decorative banner blocks and repetitive narrative sections.

## Steps
1. Remove banner and decorative image blocks from README.
2. Rewrite top profile description using LinkedIn-aligned language.
3. Trim or merge repetitive sections into a concise layout.
4. Standardize stack badges and ensure logo-icon correctness.
5. Validate readability and link integrity.

## Acceptance Criteria
- README has no banner visual blocks.
- Intro clearly describes profile in concise recruiter-friendly language.
- Redundant sections are removed, resulting in a shorter and cleaner README.
- Stack badges use correct technology logos and consistent styling.
- Core proof sections (featured work, selected projects, GitHub stats, contact) remain.
